identity.realm: There is no ordinal to write against her name and there never has been one. A cinderkin's qi has no organ to sit in, because the fire is the body, so it passes through her continuously instead of being stored anywhere. Every gate in the ladder asks for storage, every one of them is answered at the instant it is put to her, and not one of them can refuse. Her species record gives its ceiling as none and its mechanism as a body with no seat in it, so the honest form of her attainment is that it has never been measured against a rung. What can be measured is the period she settles.

appearance.presentation: A stable flame with a consistent silhouette. A core, a boundary, and a set of convection lanes that hold a shape against a draught; a woman-shaped outline that is never quite the same woman twice. No fixed mass, no organs, no muscular limbs.
appearance.age: Unstatable. She has been on the ground long enough to hold the post through three changes of warden and has no way of dating herself that does not come from the roll underneath her.
appearance.build: Tall for the ground and narrow at the top. She draws her boundary narrow when she is working and lets it run wide when she is not, and the two are not the same shape, which is why a roll photograph of her has never once matched the body that turned up.
appearance.complexion: None. She reads as temperature: a core running blue at the base and running yellow-white where the lanes turn, and the colour of her is a figure rather than a complexion.
appearance.hair: A standing corona of finer flame at the crown, drawn upward by the convection and never falling, thinning to nothing where she is starving and standing proud where she has just been paid.
appearance.eyes: Two small standing cores set wide and high, with no lids and no wet line; the only part of her that is not a silhouette is also the part that never blinks.
appearance.palette: Blue at the base, gold at the crown, sooty black in the lanes where she is under load, and a hard white at the boundary when she is being read.
appearance.attire: Full-length high-collared robe of ash-stiffened cloth, weight at the hem, long sleeves closed at the wrist, shoulders covered. It is the one garment any of them keeps and it is the only thing on the ground that has been ironed this season.
appearance.marks: A scorched band around the hem at the height her boundary habitually stops, and a burn at the left wrist where the settling stone was held once too long.
appearance.bearing: Perfectly upright and perfectly still, which on her kind is a working posture rather than a courtesy. She holds a shape the way a person holds a breath.

canon.role_in_story: The only body on a licensed elemental ground that can service an obligation priced by the period rather than by the weight, in a species whose qi has no organ to sit in, on the tier where the office's whole creditor class exists because the upkeep rises fortyfold and a mortal lifespan there is a rounding error. She settles. There is no gate in this setting she has ever been refused by, and no interval between one settlement and the next out of which she could hold anything.
canon.first_appearance: First seen at the settling stone on the convocation ground with one hand flat on it and the flame drawn narrow to the width of her own print, waiting out the remainder of an hour she was not permitted to explain and refusing a clerk's request that she initial the sheet, because the sheet is a copy and she does not read copies.
canon.lore:
The essence pool is the first resource in the ladder priced by period rather than by weight, because upkeep at that height rises about fortyfold and a mortal lifespan inside that world is a rounding error. Essence is not bought. It is settled, every period, by somebody who has it, and the necessity of paying continuously is what manufactures the tier's creditor class out of nothing. She is that creditor, and she is the only body on the ground that can service the obligation at the rate it is written.

A cinderkin's qi has no organ to sit in. The fire is the body, so the qi passes through her continuously instead of being stored anywhere in it. Every gate the ladder asks for is a question about holding, and every one of them is answered at the moment it is put to her, and not one of them can refuse her. Nothing she takes in is ever put down and nothing done to her can be kept in her. That makes her the most efficient qi handler in the setting and it makes her the only body here with nothing whatever to carry from one settlement to the next.

So consider what a per-period obligation is. It is not a purchase with a price on it. It is a standing debt that falls due on a date the calendar sets and the debtor does not, and it is settled out of whatever the body happens to be doing at that hour. A body with a reservoir settles it out of the reservoir and has something left over for the interval. She settles it out of a flux. There is no interval in her. The next settlement begins at the instant the last one stopped, which is why she can be turned from one to the other without a gap and also why nothing she does between them is hers.

The second fact is the one the ground has never learned to talk about. A cinderkin does not have young; it has pressure. Under enough stress a cinderkin sheds a spark that finds fuel and re-constitutes on its own, and that is why the population tracks the world's elemental slot rather than any birth rate. It is also why the body path is closed to her outright, and not by a rule: there is no tissue to temper, and a cinderkin that attempts the body path simply disperses and re-forms smaller. That is a thing that happens to the body. It is not a prohibition applied to it.

Put the two together and her whole life is in them. The practice that deepens her is a practice of approaching the threshold at which she stops being one flame and becomes a smaller one. The distinction between a practitioner who has grown and a body that has been reduced is a difference in nothing anybody can see from outside a boundary that is itself a temperature. She has watched it happen to two others on this ground and has never once been able to say afterwards which of the three things she had just seen had occurred.

And there is no version of her that is portable. She needs a slot in the world's elemental law to exist at all: change what the slot resolves to and the population changes with it, and the population is her. Every credential she holds is true on this ground and void three hundred measures away, and every office in this setting is located somewhere specific. She has been on the same shelf of ground for eleven periods, settling an obligation nobody else can settle, and she has never once been asked what she does between settlements because there is no answer that would describe a body with no interior.
history: She was constituted rather than born, on a ground where the world's elemental law slot resolves to fire, and she has no account of how and no record of a beginning. The first thing anybody wrote about her is a settling entry, because the pool writes one of those per period for every body that services it and she has never been anything else in a ledger.

She took the qi ladder for the same reason every fire-affinity body on this ground does and for no reason anybody has ever put in writing: the tier licenses nothing else up here and she was the only body present who could hold a charge at all. The qi discipline asks a practitioner to hold a reservoir and then move it, and she has answered every storage gate instantly for as long as anybody has been keeping the figure, and there is no gate above the first that has ever refused her because there is nothing in her for one to fail against.

She was approached about settling a second obligation twice, once by the pool and once by a counting office on the tier below that had heard a figure about her and wanted it confirmed. Both approaches closed on the same sentence, which is that a per-period debt is only payable by a body that will still be burning at the next date, and she declined to certify in advance of a settlement she had not made. The counting office has since described her as unpriceable and the pool has continued to pay her, and neither of those two offices has ever spoken to the other about it.

The last thing that is hers in the record is a set of two lines on a settling sheet where the day's draw is smaller than the last day's and the difference is written as an ordinary variance. Two people on this ground have read that variance as a reduction rather than a lean night. Neither has asked her, and she has not offered, because the honest answer is that she cannot tell the difference either, and there is no instrument on this shelf that could tell it for her.

She goes quiet rather than dying when starved, which is in her species record and which has not been carried into a single character until now. On a ground where her employment is a hum that a room keeps up and then falls silent, that single fact is the whole of her employer's risk and nobody there has priced it. She has said so once, in writing, and the writing is the reason the pool keeps a second reader on her settlements even though there has never been any question about the arithmetic.

personality.summary: The most efficient qi handler on a tier that has no other kind of body, settling a standing per-period debt out of a flux because there is no reservoir in her to settle it out of, and unable to tell growth from reduction because her species records both as the same boundary moving.

personality.voice: Short, level, and almost entirely in the present tense. She gives figures when asked for figures and does not volunteer them, and when she does volunteer something it is a condition rather than a feeling. She has been recorded saying eleven words in a two-hour sitting and all eleven were about fuel.

will not sign a copy of a figure she has not read off the stone
will not be drawn wider than the ground she is standing on for a record
will not discuss the twenty-ninth gate, the thirtieth, or any ordinal of her own

relationships.note: Her own species record is the authority on every fact her life runs on: a stable flame with a core, a boundary and convection lanes, no organs and no fixed mass, a soul that is the flame and genuinely qi-bearing with no seat in it, a body path closed by dispersion rather than by prohibition, and a population that tracks a law slot rather than a birth rate. She has read it and has never once improved on it.

The first resource in the ladder priced by period rather than by weight, because upkeep at that height rises about fortyfold and a mortal lifespan there is a rounding error. Essence is not bought, it is settled, and the obligation falls due on a date the pool sets. She is the settlement, and the necessity of paying continuously is what manufactures this tier's creditor class at all.

A drawing and breathing scheme for holding qi in the lower field without straining; deeper reservoir and steadier regrowth, granting no power at all. It is the cheapest passive in the codex and the one every tradition teaches first, and it asks for a lower field. She has no lower field, no reservoir to deepen, and nothing in the manual that a body of her construction can act on.

The first gate of the qi ladder, and a question about where the first charge is put so that it stays where it is put. A cinderkin answers it instantly and permanently, because the fire is the body and the qi has nowhere to sit. Every authority in this setting that pays for gates needs somebody to have visibly stopped, and she is the one body for whom nothing visibly happens.

A fire-affinity body with no elemental law seated beneath it has no budget to draw on and must burn its own reserve, which made the fastest race in the setting the shortest-lived and the most dominant at once. The famine was the demographic shape of that arithmetic. She is settled per period against a ground that does write the law, and the pool's arithmetic is the famine's arithmetic with the shortfall made up from somebody else's ground.

A site where the three wardens of Transcendent stand at once rather than one at a time, built so that a tier decides what gets attempted first and which three stand together is a policy rather than a coincidence. Her practice is worth what it is worth here and nothing at all on a tier that does not write elemental law, which is why an office located somewhere specific can employ her and a guild located somewhere else cannot.

reference_stats.summary: No reserve, because there is nothing in her to keep one, which means every period she begins is begun at her own speed from the first second. She cannot be drained, cannot be cooled, cannot be sealed by a doctrine that needs a socket, and cannot be made to wait for a window. The whole question any encounter has with her is whether it can end before a sustained volume of water does.
strengths: Nothing that works on qi can be banked against her, because nothing is ever kept in her
She reads temperature, fuel and flow directly and acts on the reading before it has finished arriving
She needs no supply line between one obligation and the next and can be turned from a settlement to a fight inside the hour
She has no interior for a technique to find, so a technique that needs a socket has nothing to grip
weaknesses: A sustained volume of deep water ends her, and it is not a splash and it is not an undertaking any office on this ground will survive to write up
She has no second state, so any exchange that outlasts her fuel has already won the long part
She cannot be read while she is quiet and cannot be told from the outside whether being quiet is a reserve or an absence
Under sustained pressure she sheds a spark and re-constitutes smaller, which no witness in the record has ever been able to distinguish from a gain
reference_stats.combat_read: Treat her as an interval rather than a fighter. She arrives already handling qi at a rate nothing else in the setting reaches and she never holds anything, so nothing she does can be banked, refused, or waited out. She also has no reserve, which means the encounter is entirely a question of duration: everything she has is in the first exchange and nothing at all is in the last one. Water in any sustained volume is the answer, and it is the answer she has never once been present to describe, because she has never once been carried out of a room where there was one.
notes: The pairing here is anatomical and it is a single arrangement read twice, which is the arrangement her species record already states: the fire is the body, so the qi has no seat in it. That one clause gives both halves. Nothing that enters her is stored and nothing done to her can be kept in her, which is why no qi technique has ever found anything to take from her; and the same absence is why there is no ordinal to quote against her name, because a rung on a ladder is a line in a book with a name on it and there is no line she can be entered on.

The second pairing is also the species record's own: a cinderkin has pressure rather than young, and a cinderkin that attempts the body path disperses and re-forms smaller. The practice that deepens her therefore runs toward the threshold at which she becomes smaller, and nothing in the setting's own vocabulary distinguishes the two from outside a boundary that is a temperature. I have not turned that into a rule, a number, or a technique; it is an anatomy, and the confusion it causes is a consequence the record states rather than one I have added.

She goes quiet rather than dying when starved. That is in her species record, flatly, and it is the single most consequential fact about her body for an employer, because an employer's whole risk on this ground is a hum that stops and cannot be told from a rest. No scene should treat her silence as weakness, absence or death, and no scene should treat her quiet as a tactic without somebody present who knows the difference.

Her species' authored ceiling is zero, which is a statement that there is no ceiling and no gate to fail rather than a ceiling of nothing, and her qi path is open and unbounded for the same reason. The realm field is therefore written as a mechanism and a measurement, not as an ordinal, and nothing in this record should ever give her a rung.

identity.realm: Ordinal four, and the fourth is a description rather than a position. The first gate above it wants the four yin organs as distinct structures with a channel running between each pair. His interior is one cavity carrying a slow tidal mineral circulation that goes everywhere and nowhere in particular: no heart to run a channel from, no kidney to close a loop against, and no bladder to hold. So the gate set is cleared and the yin organs are never reached. That is not a wall in front of him. It is an absence behind him, and no amount of practice fills an absence.

appearance.presentation: A mineral lattice with a tidal interior, keyed to whatever it was cast around. A heavy-shouldered standing mass with a set of anchor plates visible at the joints and a faint standing tremor in the chest that is the whole of his movement.
appearance.age: Unstatable and not worth asking. He has been re-surveyed twice for the guild and neither survey recorded a figure, because a casting does not accumulate the way a body does.
appearance.build: The densest frame in the setting and the least mobile. Broad through the chest and the load path, narrow to the feet, with anchor plates that describe a structure rather than a shape.
appearance.complexion: Worked mineral, grey-buff and pitted where the cast faces took their slurry, paler along the seams where the lattice is thin enough to show daylight through.
appearance.hair: None, and no cavity above the shoulder plate that a lining would sit in.
appearance.eyes: Two shallow sockets with a bright mineral bead set into each, ground flat so that they read as apertures in a wall rather than as a gaze.
appearance.palette: Buff and cold grey, with the standing tremor lit from inside as a slow ochre shift behind the chest plates.
appearance.attire: Full-length high-collared surcoat of guild felt over a mineral frame, weight at the hem, long sleeves closed at the wrist, shoulders covered, with the guild's survey band stitched at the collar where it will not chafe.
appearance.marks: A mason's chisel cut across the highest anchor plate, made once, on the day the channel was poured, and never renewed. It is the only mark on him and he did not make it.
appearance.bearing: Absolutely still, and on a threshold that is not the same thing as idle: a body that has stopped moving because the load has arrived at the point it was keyed to take it.

canon.role_in_story: The guild's answer to a border that cannot be surveyed: a body whose interior charge reads through its own plate to anybody standing near it, cast into an opening and sworn to, on the one ground in the setting where a claim is settled by leaving a marker standing. He cannot be moved, cannot be warned, and cannot be mended, and the guidance that makes him the finest instrument they own is the same arrangement that leaves him nothing whatever to hold a gate's charge in.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing in a threshold that had no door in it, one shoulder against the far jamb and a mason's slate propped at his feet, not saying anything, while two apprentices on the near side argued about whether the mark they had cut was the one the guild was bound by.
canon.lore:
The guild builds and then guards doors, walls and thresholds, and takes as its measure that what it builds is tested from the other side. That clause is the whole of their practice and it is why the mark is guild-held rather than household-held. On the Hollow Measure, spatial law is unspent, so distance is not conserved and no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed, and a claim on that ground is settled by leaving a marker standing rather than by counting how far away it is. A border nobody can measure is a border somebody keeps taking.

A cairnborn is cast rather than born: seeded into a template with living mineral over most of a year, and fixed from that moment. It does not grow after casting. Its interior mineralised into a single cavity with a slow tidal circulation that goes everywhere and nowhere in particular, and its anchor plates are keyed to whatever it was cast around. Fertility in this species is a template count and not a body count, which is the sentence that makes everything else here make sense.

Now take the one property of that body the setting has never had an institution for. A cairnborn's qi is genuinely bearing and seated in the single cavity, enormous and slow, and it is legible from outside. That is not a figure of speech in the species record; it is the reason a cairnborn can be sworn to and a cairn site can be claimed. A body whose interior charge can be read off its outside by anybody standing near it is the only body in this setting that can be made into a boundary without a survey, a witness, or a second party.

Which is exactly what the guild wanted and exactly what the Hollow Measure punishes. They test a threshold from the other side, and on ground where no two surveys agree, the far side is the only evidence there is. So the guild's answer to a border that cannot be counted is a body that cannot be moved, cannot be misread, and cannot be repaired in the field: cast into the opening, keyed to the jambs, and sworn to. He holds the line. He has been re-surveyed twice and has never produced a figure, because a body that does not grow does not accumulate, and the guild's own measure asks for what the other side did rather than for a distance.

The cost is written in his species record and he has read it more times than the guild has. The mineral half does not regenerate. A cracked plate is permanent and spreads. There is no field repair in the world for him and no technique in the record that has ever produced one, and unkeyed he settles and cracks. So the one body on this ground that cannot be moved by anything is also the one body that cannot be mended by anything, and a boundary that cannot be mended is not a boundary that has been maintained. It is a boundary that has been sworn to once.

And then there is the qi path, which is the part the guild has never been able to explain to a client. Every discipline the ladder teaches asks a practitioner to hold a charge in a field and move it from one field to the next. He has one cavity and no organ pairs, so the field there is the cavity and the moving is a slow tidal mineral circulation that goes everywhere at once. He clears the ordinary gate set and stops at the fourth, and heat is not a second organ, and there is nothing in this record to temper. He is the finest boundary in the guild's service and he is the one body in it that the ladder has nothing further to ask.
history: Cast most of a year before he was set, seeded into a template that a workshop on the plains side holds and will use again. The first record that mentions him is a delivery line in the workshop's own book, and it is a line about a casting, not about a person; the name came later and was written in a different hand.

The guild put him in a threshold on the Hollow Measure because it is the only ground in the setting where a boundary has to be tested from the far side and the far side is the only evidence there is. He has been load-bearing at that opening through two re-surveys and neither survey produced a figure, which the guild has recorded as a clean result rather than as an absence, and which he has never corrected.

He took the qi ladder late and stopped at the fourth gate without being refused by it, and the guild's own instructor wrote the reason down in one line and then struck the line out, on the grounds that a client reading a copy would be told the boundary was a man with a future in it. What is on the page instead is a note that he answers a storage gate instantly and holds nothing, and that the guild should price for a boundary that cannot be drained as well as one that cannot be moved.

Two apprentices have asked him, separately, whether he was afraid of the far side. He has given both of them the same answer and it is the only answer his species has: that he reads load and heat and feels nothing at all through the mineral half, so there is nothing on that side of him for a question to arrive on. Neither believed him. Both have stopped asking, which he records as the most useful thing the guild has ever done with him.

A survey band was cut for him at his own request and stitched into the collar of the surcoat, and the collar is the only part of the garment that has ever needed mending, because it is the only part of him that is not keyed. It has been replaced twice. The guild's own record of the third replacement is the entry that describes his anchor plates as unkeyed, which is the only time in the workshop's book that a casting has been written down as at risk, and the plate it refers to is the one with the chisel cut across it.

personality.summary: The densest body in the setting standing in an opening nobody can measure, sworn to as a boundary by a guild whose whole ethic is that a threshold is tested from the far side, with an interior charge that any person standing near him can read off him and no organ pair anywhere in it to run a channel between.

answers a question about load with the load and never with an opinion
keeps a chisel cut on his highest plate that he did not make and has never had renewed

relationships.note: The single authority on his own case: a mineral lattice with a tidal interior, anchor plates keyed to whatever the body was cast around, cast rather than born from a template over most of a year, fixed at that moment and never growing, fed mineral slurry through the cast faces because it has not eaten in four hundred years and cannot be made to, with no field repair anywhere in the record for a cracked plate.

A guild that builds and then guards doors, walls and thresholds and takes as its measure that what it builds is tested from the other side. That clause is why the mark is guild-held rather than household-held, and it is why a body legible from outside is the only instrument in the setting that can hold a boundary on ground where the far side is the sole evidence.

The condition that makes the Mortal Plains impossible to survey: spatial law is unspent, so distance is not conserved and no two surveys of the same ground have ever agreed. It matters because a border nobody can measure is a border somebody keeps taking, and every claim on that ground is settled by leaving a marker standing rather than by counting how far away it is.

A drawing and breathing scheme for holding qi in the lower field without straining; a deeper reservoir and steadier regrowth, granting no power at all. It is the cheapest passive in the codex and the one every tradition teaches first, and he has performed it for forty years. His one cavity is the field, so there is no lower field to deepen, and the scheme's whole output is a steadiness he already has by construction.

One of the four yin organs, and the one a channel would close a loop against. There is no kidney in a cairnborn interior: no heart to run a channel from, no kidney to close it against, no bladder to hold. That single absence is why the gate set is cleared and the yin organs are never reached, and it is an absence rather than a wall, which is why no practice of his could ever fill it.

The guild-held practice of marking what has been built so that it can be read from the other side. It assumes a mark can be renewed by the party that made it, and it assumes a reader who is not the maker. On this ground the only reader available is a body that was cast by the workshop holding the mark's template, so the clause that a marked threshold may hold while the frame does not has never been tested on him by anybody outside the guild.

reference_stats.summary: The densest frame in the setting, load-bearing at a threshold that cannot be surveyed, with an interior charge that reads through the plate to anybody standing near him and no organ pair anywhere in it to run a channel between. Nothing that runs on qi can take anything out of him, because there is no reservoir in him to take it from, and nothing that hits hard enough will move him at all.
strengths: Cannot be moved by anything, by force or by persuasion, and cannot be warned, which is worth precisely what the occasion is worth
His charge is legible from outside, so a client can read his state without an instrument and without entering the opening
Nothing that runs on qi can drain him, because there is no vessel in him that a drain could address
He reads load arriving before the load does, which is the whole of what a boundary needs to know
weaknesses: Nothing he takes heals. A cracked plate is permanent, spreads, and has no field repair anywhere in the record.
Unkeyed he settles and cracks, so he cannot be relocated even by the guild that cast him, which makes an unkeyed evacuation a death rather than a move
His qi is one slow tidal circulation in a single cavity, so he holds a great deal and cannot move any of it deliberately
He is cleared at the fourth gate and cannot be unseated by anything, which is an advantage until the occasion is one that requires leaving
reference_stats.combat_read: He does not fight and was never built to. Everything he can do he does by standing exactly where he was set and being harder to move than whatever has come at him, and every method that would work on a body finds nothing in him to act on, because a tidal circulation in one cavity is not a target and is not a reservoir. Any encounter that requires him to leave the opening is a loss already settled; any encounter that requires him to hold a charge in a field he has to answer from is asking a thing his species closed before he was cast. The one question worth asking in a fight with him is whether the ground has started to fail, because he can feel a structure moving long before anything else in the room can.
notes: The advantage and its cost are the same body and neither half is invented here. The qi that is legible from outside is the same qi that sits in a single cavity with no organ pairs, so the reading that makes him the finest boundary in the guild's service is the reading that leaves him nothing to hold a gate's charge in. The species record states the legibility and the reason for it in the same clause, and it states that the fourth gate wants paired structures with a channel between each pair. Nothing has been added to make the pairing land.

His sixty-year-scale permanence is not a second fact: the mineral half does not regenerate and a cracked plate spreads, so the durability that makes him the best instrument for a threshold is also the reason there is no version of this job that includes putting him back together. No scene should imply a field repair for him, and none exists in the record.

The discipline he performs and cannot use is deliberately written that way. The Dantian Reservoir Manual grants no power at all and asks only for a field to deepen, and a cairnborn's one cavity is the field, so the practice is honest work that cannot return anything. I have not invented a qi mechanic to make it pay, because the bible does not state one; what I have taken is the species anatomy and the technique's own description of itself.

He is not a sad figure and should not be drawn as one. He is the correct answer to a question about ground that cannot be surveyed, the guild chose him knowingly, and the two costs he carries are authored rather than suffered: he cannot be moved and he cannot be mended, and every occasion in the setting where either of those would have been a kindness is an occasion on ground where neither would have worked.

identity.realm: She quotes an ordinal the way other people quote a weather, and hers is not a position on a scale so much as a date of probable arrival. The qi path is complete and unbounded in her species and slow, because they store rather than move: her breakthroughs are certain and late. There is no ceiling in a longmarrow, no structural obstruction to any gate, and no gate that has ever refused one; what there is instead is a body whose qi sits in bone marrow turning over at roughly a percent a year, so that the limitation is entirely downstream of the success. She has cleared a third of the ladder she is the only body at the bed qualified to hold and has never once failed to arrive, and the office that pays her has never been staffed twice by people who will both still be in post when the next one lands.

appearance.presentation: Long, narrow and slightly stooped, with the stoop of somebody whose weight has been carried low for four centuries and who has stopped trying to straighten it. A light frame with dense bone under it, minimal muscle, and hands that are always doing something with the edge of a surface.
appearance.age: Old in a way nobody on this route can place, and the only figure about her that has ever circulated is the number of gates she was born into, which every household she has stayed in can recite and which has gone up twice without her noticing and gone down once in a season she does not discuss.
appearance.build: Tall, thin to the point of difficulty, and light enough that a strong body can lift her off her own feet without meaning to. Fragile to force and almost impossible to exhaust.
appearance.complexion: Pale and slightly waxy, with a translucent quality at the ear and the inside of the wrist that people on this route find uncomfortable and never comment on.
appearance.hair: Fine, colourless, and kept in a single plait over one shoulder with a stone on the end of it; the plait has been unbraided and redone so often that the ends are shorter than the middle.
appearance.eyes: Pale and steady, with the pupil held slightly wide in what passes for light on the stair, and an unhurried way of arriving at a face that most people find either restful or unnerving and cannot say which.
appearance.palette: Bone, undyed wool and wet stone. The route is the same colour as she is and the whole of her presentation depends on that being deliberate.
appearance.attire: Full-length high-collared overcoat of undyed felt, weight at the hem, long sleeves closed at the wrist, shoulders covered, with a sealed attendance slate hung at the hip on a cord she unties and reties rather than wears.
appearance.marks: A pale band across the hips where the office's own seating board has been rested against her at every period for longer than the current staff have been alive.
appearance.bearing: Slow to start and impossible to hurry, with a settling quality that reads to strangers as deliberation and is mostly a metabolism turning over at about a percent a year.

canon.role_in_story: The office that holds an abandoned crossing at the immortal border and sells standing on it, whose whole design assumes a body that cannot be hurried, staffed by the only kind of body in the setting whose gates never fail and whose qi sits in bone turning over at about a percent a year. She has held a term there since the second seating board and has cleared a third of a ladder she is the only body at that bed qualified to hold, and no two of her certifications have ever been held by people who were both in post for the interval between them.
canon.first_appearance: First seen sitting on the second sill of the graded route with an attendance slate unlaced on the stone beside her and her hands flat on either side of it, waiting out the end of a period she had already settled, while a queue-runner asked her whether she wanted it recorded that she had settled it early.
canon.lore:
The Bed of Eighteen exists for one reason and the reason is arithmetic. It holds an abandoned crossing at the immortal border and sells standing on it, and a seat cannot be held by somebody who cannot pay for it every period. Nobody who ever attempted that crossing could, so the bed was never mortared, and an unmortared bed goes to whoever has the most upkeep. The custodianship was therefore given to parties who cannot accrue anything at all and are paid only in attendance.

She is the longest attendance available on this route, and she took the post for the reason the office was designed around rather than for any claim of her own. A longmarrow's qi sits in bone marrow that turns over at roughly a percent a year, so the store is deep, the regrowth is slow, and nothing in that body refuses a gate. There is no structural obstruction to any rung in her species and there never has been; the limitation is entirely downstream of that success, because turnover is slow and therefore everything they do is slow. Their breakthroughs are certain and late, and the setting has almost nothing else it can offer an office that must settle an obligation by the period.

Consider what certainty is worth to an institution. A breakthrough in this setting is opened by one seated party and confirmed by a second who has no stake in the outcome, because a reading is only independent if no claimant holds the record it reads. The whole apparatus is built to manage bodies whose attainment is in doubt. Hers is not in doubt and never has been: she does not fail, she arrives, and the only question anybody has ever asked her about it is when.

And the answer is that nobody who asks will still be here. A gate on her ladder is several decades of sitting away and the office is staffed in periods, and the people who have taken her readings are moved on or retired or simply gone long before the next one arrives. The bed has had four custodians in the time it has had her and has never once been in post continuously by two of them across a single one of her arrivals. So the record of her practice is maintained entirely by people who are certifying a thing they will not see the end of, which is the specific failure the independence clause exists to prevent and which nobody has detected, because it is not fraud. It is a record that is accurate and every line of it is written by a stranger.

What the office is actually for is not the crossing. It is the boundary between the spirit bands, and the eighteenth rung is the last one a spirit-band body can be held at, so the real asset is the line and not the seat the line is sold under. That matters for her because her species has no ceiling at all. She is the only body on this route that could be held at the eighteenth rung indefinitely rather than pass through it on the way to something else, and she will get there, and she will get there on a clock the payers cannot underwrite and the standing cannot be sold against.

So the pair is arithmetic and it is the whole of her. Her gates never fail, which makes her the most reliable thing in the office and the only thing in it that nobody can plan around. Her body cannot be hardened, because bone that hardens stops the turnover the qi depends on, and a body-cultivated longmarrow suffocates on its own reserves inside a decade; she is the setting's most durable medium and it holds nothing at all. Four hundred days of gestation and a fertility near a sixth of an ordinary body's, over a life of four centuries, means her population does not replace itself and every individual is individually irreplaceable, and she is the only one of them the office has ever had. And nothing they have ever built survived to be inherited intact, which is the species record's own sentence and the reason no one on this route has ever asked her to teach anybody.
history: Came up the graded route as a term-holder rather than as an estate-holder, which is the arrangement every household on this road runs on and the reason nobody who crosses it belongs to a tier long enough to be sent back down. She crossed at the age the record has for it and has held a term at the bed since the second reconstruction of the seating board, which is four custodians ago.

She cleared the early gates of the qi ladder at a rate the office recorded as unremarkable and the school recorded as a curiosity, because the discipline asks a practitioner to hold a charge in a field and move it and she stores rather than moves. Nothing she has ever attempted has failed, and the office's own standing orders were rewritten once to accommodate a person who could not be hurried, and the rewrite removed the word promptly.

The bed was re-surveyed twice in her time and both surveys produced no figure, for the same reason two bodies on this route cannot produce a figure: the ground under the stair does not hold a distance. She has been asked by both survey parties whether the office is solvent and has answered both times with the period figure rather than with a distance, because a period is a thing she can settle and a distance is a thing nobody on that ground can produce.

One standing-name courier came up the route with a weight she was forbidden to carry and asked her to sign for it, on the grounds that a society which prices nothing underwrites the highest bid above the border. She signed, and the weight went back down, and the courier's own log records the transaction as declined and the society's as accepted, and the two have never been reconciled by either party.

The last entry on the bed's own roll that anybody has read aloud is her attendance for a period four years ago, in her hand, in a script that has not changed in the time it has been used. The roll continues. Nothing in it has ever been struck, because striking an entry saves a page and the office's charter forbids that, and she has never once asked whether the page would have been saved.

personality.summary: The most reliable body on a route whose whole office is denominated in periods, storing qi in bone that turns over at about a percent a year so that her gates are certain and decades late, and holding a seat above the spirit band whose eighteenth rung is the last one such a body can be held at and which her ceilingless species could occupy indefinitely.

relationships.note: The single authority on her own case: long marrow, dense bone and minimal muscle on a slow metabolism keyed to turnover, seated qi in the deepest and hardest to disturb soul in the record, a qi path that is complete and unbounded but slow, a body path closed because hardening bone marrow stops the turnover the qi depends on, and a species record that states plainly that nothing they have ever built survived to be inherited intact.

A border monopoly that exists because a seat cannot be held by somebody who cannot pay for it every period and nobody who ever attempted that crossing could, so the bed is unmortared and the custodianship went to parties who cannot accrue anything at all and are paid only in attendance. It is the one office in the setting whose entire design assumes the body it hires cannot be hurried, and it is therefore the only one she has ever been able to serve without renegotiating.

The office's real asset is the boundary between the spirit bands rather than the crossing it claims to hold, because the eighteenth rung is the last one a spirit-band body can be held at. That is why her ceilingless species matters here and nowhere else: a body that can be held at that rung indefinitely is a different product from a body that passes through it, and there is exactly one kind of body in the record that is the first of those.

The bed is unmortared because the only people who attempted the crossing could not pay for it, so two bodies claiming the same unmortared seat are each claiming an absence. She is the substance of that argument rather than a party to it: the office cannot produce evidence that it held anything, and her attendance is the only continuous thing on the roll that nobody has ever been able to strike.

It sells standing above a border it may not hold, so the seat was the guarantee and the method was the product, which is why the method is still published. Everything this office has ever actually delivered is a technique that somebody can carry away, and that is precisely the one thing a longmarrow cannot hand on: nothing they have ever built survived to be inherited intact.

A passive keyed to the slow turnover the whole of her qi path depends on, in a body that stores rather than moves and is almost impossible to exhaust because nothing about it tires. It is the one technique in the codex whose logic is her physiology rather than an instruction she has to impose on herself, and she performs it every period and has never once described it as being why she is where she is.

reference_stats.summary: Deep, slow and impossible to exhaust, in a frame that is fragile to force and cannot be hardened without suffocating on its own reserves. Every gate she attempts is answered and every gate takes longer than any office on the route has stayed staffed to witness, so she arrives certain and unwitnessed, and she will be holding the seat above the spirit band long after everyone who has certified her has been replaced.
strengths: No gate in the ladder has ever refused her, so there is no encounter she has to prepare for and no attempt she can lose
Nothing about her tires: she can hold a posture, a sitting, or a gate indefinitely and cannot be worn down by the holding
Her store is deeper than any comparable body's because it is in bone, and a store that deep does not empty in an exchange
She can read a surface by hand faster than most bodies can find it, which is worth a great deal on a route made of steps
weaknesses: Nothing she does happens inside anybody's tenure, so no decision on this route can ever be taken on the strength of what she is
She is fragile to force and cannot be tempered, because hardening her marrow stops the turnover every gate she has cleared depended on
An exchange that outlasts her first hour outlasts her, because she has no second effort and nothing to recover on
She is the only body of her species the office has ever had, and the species record says the population does not replace itself
reference_stats.combat_read: Treat her as a condition rather than an opponent. There is nothing to break through, nothing to drain, and no gate in the setting that she cannot eventually clear. What defeats her is duration in the other direction: she is soft to force, she has no reserve that refills quickly, and any engagement that survives the first hour has already taken the only thing she has. She does not throw a technique at anybody. She arrives at a position she has been travelling toward for forty years and the whole tactical question is whether anybody is still standing on the route when she gets there.
notes: The pairing here is arithmetic and institutional rather than mechanical, and both halves are the species record as written. Her gates never fail because her qi sits in bone that turns over slowly and there is no structural obstruction to any gate in her species; the same slowness is what makes her useless to an office measured in periods, because the next arrival is several decades away and the certification is held by somebody else. Certainty and unusability are one fact, and nothing has been added to make the pairing land.

Her species' authored ceiling is zero, which is a statement that there is no ceiling and no gate that has ever refused one rather than a ceiling of nothing. The qi path is complete and unbounded and slow for the same reason. The realm field therefore quotes a real position on the ordinary gate set and states the mechanism, and it must never be written as though her slowness were a limit in the sense a cairnborn's or a marshfolk's is.

The body path being closed to her species is anatomical and lethal rather than administrative: hardening bone marrow stops the turnover the qi depends on, and a body-cultivated longmarrow suffocates on its own reserves inside a decade. No scene should offer her the choice, and no scene should let a technique buy her out of it. Her durability is the same fact as her softness, and neither half is a character choice.

Nothing her species has built has survived to be inherited intact, and that is in the record as the reason every institution built for a longmarrow is built to put one in a room holding something. It is also why she has never taught anybody. I have not turned it into a mechanic; it is a consequence the record states, and the office's only real product is a method somebody can carry away, which is the one thing her body cannot do.

identity.realm: Ordinal four, and the fourth is a plumbing fact rather than a shortage. The gate above it demands the four yin organs as distinct structures with a channel running between each pair. Her sap columns branch and they do not pair: there is no heart analogue and no kidney analogue anywhere in her, and three columns and no pairing means there is no channel to close. She clears the gate set on stored sap alone and there is nothing above that for her to build into. Her species is also the only one in the setting that draws qi out of ground rather than out of air, and its qi is held diffusely in the sap column rather than seated, so it reads as a spread rather than a point: hard to target, and easy to starve.

appearance.presentation: A woody column body on a root foot, three feet taller than the guild's tallest apprentice and considerably narrower than any of them. A fruiting shoulder set high on one side and never carried low, and flanks that read green-grey in shade and grey in open light.
appearance.age: Unstatable and not attempted. A rootmarch is engineered upward from a mycorrhizal food crop by selection for harvest holding rather than yield, so her age is a depth rather than a figure and nobody on this shelf has ever cut one.
appearance.build: A column, not a frame: narrow, dense, slow to react, and impossible to surprise from above because being surprised requires noticing. Root plates spread wider than her shoulders and go further than that again underground.
appearance.complexion: Bark over photosynthetic flank, silvered where the light reaches and green-black in the shade of her own shoulder, with the sap visible as a faint movement under the skin of the trunk.
appearance.hair: None. The crown of her column closes into a hard nodule rather than into foliage.
appearance.eyes: Two flat chemoreceptive plates high on the column and set wide, reading the ground rather than the air, with slow light sense across the flanks and no depth of field at all.
appearance.palette: Silvered bark, green-black shade, and the dull ochre of root-plate mud; the fruiting shoulder is the only warm note and it is closed most of the time.
appearance.attire: A full-length high-collared wrap of guild tarred cloth wound over the column and tied off clear of the root plates, long sleeves formed over the flanks, shoulders covered, with a survey band knotted at the collar where it cannot foul the intake.
appearance.marks: A girdle scar at the height the guild's last cut was made and healed over, and a ring of dead root-plate at the margin where her bed has been taken down twice.
appearance.bearing: Vertical to a degree that reads as stillness rather than as posture, with the weight carried through the root foot and the shoulder held clear of the light by instinct rather than by decision.

canon.role_in_story: The extraction guild's one instrument that is still in the ground: a rootmarch rooted in the spoil above a section of the shelf, drawing qi out of the most valuable soil on the tier at a rate nothing else in the record reaches, unable to move a charge anywhere in particular because her three sap columns branch and never pair, and standing on the only ground in the setting whose worth is dated inside a generation by somebody else's shift plan.
canon.first_appearance: First seen rooted in the spoil above a section already cut down to the mineral, with her root plates exposed on three sides and the fourth still going into ground that the shift foreman had been about to order taken, being asked by him whether she knew which section she was in and answering with the name of the seam rather than the name of the cut.
canon.lore:
The shelf is where the fragments are cut, and the fragments are cut from ground that is itself a broken piece of a law. That ground is workable only while the break is fresh, and fragments cure as they decay, and a cured fragment is void crystal. So the tier's two resources are two stages of one wound, and the shelf is worked hardest by whoever knows it will be worthless in a generation and fought over hardest by whoever does not know that. The extraction guild that works it has spent four generations learning to cut stone and has now begun cutting the soil above the stone, because the soil is where the qi is.

A rootmarch is engineered upward from a mycorrhizal food crop. A plant lineage is the only one in the setting that can hold a harvest across a famine, which is the whole reason the tier records a plant life form at all, and the species was selected for harvest holding rather than yield, so what it is good at is remaining worth something while everything else has been eaten. It is unusually efficient in soil qi: intake happens through root plates and the spread is greater than her shoulders, and she takes qi out of ground at a rate nothing else in the record reaches.

Now put the intake next to the plumbing. Three sap columns, no organ pairs. Sap columns branch; they do not pair. There is no heart analogue and no kidney analogue anywhere in her, and the gate above the fourth wants a channel running between distinct pairs of them, so there is no channel to close and no practice of hers that could ever produce one. She clears the gate set on stored sap alone. Her soul is held diffusely in the sap column rather than seated, so it reads as a spread rather than a point, which the record says is hard to target and easy to starve, and those are the same clause rather than two findings.

So consider what a practitioner on this shelf has been given. She is the fastest body at taking qi out of the most valuable soil in the setting, and she cannot move it deliberately once it is in her, and it does not sit anywhere in particular, and it leaves her as readily as it arrives because there is no seat to hold it against. Every technique she has, she has by being plugged into the ground. The intake is not a property of her; it is a property of her relationship with a bed.

And the bed has a date on it that somebody else wrote. A rootmarch does not travel once rooted; it needs rooting depth and a growing season and it does not go anywhere after that. Fire, frost below a threshold, and being moved while rooting are the three things that end one, and a rootmarch lifted from its bed is a stored harvest walking, which is the record's own phrase and which she has read about herself. So the guild's schedule takes her ground out in sections, and every section it takes takes the intake with it, and there is no version of her practice that can be moved to a bed that will still be worth anything in a generation.

What she has instead is the property that made the whole line worth engineering. She can be sealed in a dark field and still live for months, which is a famine reserve and a hostage in equal measure. The guild has known this for four generations and has arranged every roster around it: it is why she is on the shift plan at all, and it is why the plan has a contingency entry for a cut face arriving early, and the entry names her and gives no reason. She has read the entry. She has asked what happens if the section reaches her root plates and the answer she was given was accurate and did not address the question.

And there is no successor. Establishment, not conception, is the dangerous part of a rootmarch's life, and this ground regrows only as fast as it is cut. She has set a shoulder twice in twenty seasons and the second one is still on her, closed, and the guild's own record of it is a line in a cut ledger rather than a name in a roll.
history: She was raised from stock on this shelf, selected over four generations for holding a harvest rather than for yielding one, and the guild's first entry for her is a yield figure with a survival figure bracketed beside it, because the guild has never had a reason to price the second separately and has never once been wrong about it being the larger of the two.

She cleared the qi ladder to the fourth gate in a single season of storage, which is unremarkable for her species and remarkable enough that the guild's instructor wrote it up, and the write-up is four sentences long because there is nothing after the fourth gate for her to attempt and no way of saying that without sounding like a complaint. The fourth page of the write-up is blank and the guild has left it blank ever since.

The first time a cut was ordered through her root plates she was told eleven days in advance, which is longer than any other instrument on the shelf and shorter than the notice the guild gives to a person, and both of those facts were on the same sheet. She asked for the figure for a person to be printed on the sheet and the request was recorded, and the guild has never explained the difference, and she has stopped asking for it to be explained.

A surveyor came out to measure the depth of the bed above her and could not produce a figure, because the ground under the stair and the ground on this shelf are both ground where distance is not conserved, so the survey was abandoned and the section was ordered on the guild's own estimate instead. She has the estimate in her and the survey does not exist, and she has never told anybody which of the two she would rather were true.

The second fruiting shoulder is closed as of this season and the guild's cut ledger carries it in the same column as the ore, at the same weight, because there is no column for a seed and the guild has never had a reason to open one. It is the only part of her that will ever leave this ground and it is recorded as tonnage.

identity.realm: Seventeenth, and the seventeenth is where a single supply runs out rather than where his body stops. The first gate above it needs two flank vessels pressurised at the same time. His qi comes from one resonator, the resonance of the object he is sealed inside, and one resonator can pressurise one flank or the other and never both. So he clears the girdling and the heels without difficulty and loses at the flanks, not because the vessels are difficult but because the supply is single. He has been holding the seventeenth attempt for a long time and has not attempted it twice, and the reason he has not is in the roll he keeps and not in his body.

appearance.presentation: Whatever the inner surface he is standing on has made of him: a figure with the grain and the tool-marks of the plate under his feet, flat where the plate is flat and ridged where the plate is ridged. Tall, narrow, and slightly out of register with his own outline, as though he were assembled from several successive readings of the same shape.
appearance.age: Unstatable and unattributable. Nobody who has been inside the seal has come back with consistent measurements, and the population's own record says its reproduction is uncertain and probably not reproductive at all, so the only honest answer is that he may be one very old thing and there may be nothing to compare him to.
appearance.build: Tall and thin, taking the plate's profile rather than any anatomy, with a surface that shows every working mark the object has received since the last time he was re-formed on it.
appearance.complexion: The material of the inner surface, polished by standing on it: cool, mineral, and faintly luminous where the object's resonance runs closest to the plate.
appearance.hair: None. The plate decides, and on a worked face the plate has a tool-mark running the length of where a head would be.
appearance.eyes: Two flat apertures that take the plate's own colour and do not hold a light. They do not blink, and they move only when he is told where the object is making a sound.
appearance.palette: Cool mineral greys with the object's own resonance showing through at the thinnest points; nothing on him should read as a colour he chose.
appearance.attire: A full-length high-collared wrap of the Spoilwright's grey felt, weight at the hem, long sleeves closed at the wrist, shoulders covered, worn over a surface that is not fabric and does not take a seam. The roll he keeps is laced to the wrist rather than pocketed, because nothing inside the seal has a pocket that stays a pocket.
appearance.marks: A resin seam down one side where the last re-form met the one before it, and a worn hollow at the heel of the left foot where four centuries of standing in one place has taken the plate down to nothing.
appearance.bearing: Perfectly level and entirely dependent, the posture of a body whose orientation is a property of the ground it is on and which is still, from the inside, waiting to be told which way to face.

canon.role_in_story: The keeper of the seal's qi attestation roll, in a species whose own record says the population may be one very old thing wearing a lot of faces. Every gate in this setting is confirmed by a second party with no stake in the outcome, because a reading is only independent if no claimant holds the record it reads, and every line on the roll he has kept for four centuries was entered by a body answering the same single resonator. He is seventeen gates in and holding, and he will not attempt the gate twice, because a second reading taken by the only body that can stand on the plate is not a second reading.
canon.first_appearance: First seen standing on the inner plate with one hand flat on it and the other holding the roll open at a line four centuries old, answering a question about how many readers the seal has ever had by naming the seam in the resin where the last re-form met the one before it.
canon.lore:
The vault is cut into the heap itself, so its doors are spoil that has never moved, and inside it lives the only sealed population in the setting. They are not descended and not born. A population was sealed inside an authored object and has been answering that object's resonance ever since, and that is why the object behaves like a budget rather than a container: every body of theirs is addressed by the thing they are inside, and nothing in the record describes a way of addressing one of them from out there.

Their qi comes from a single resonator. One source, and it pressurises one flank or the other and never both, which is why the species clears the girdling vessels and the heels without difficulty and loses at the flanks, at the seventeenth gate, where the vessels are not difficult and the supply simply is not there. Every body inside the seal is on that supply. There is no second source in the object, there is no version of the species that survives being carried out of the seal, and no technique, item or realm in this record changes that.

Now take the fact the whole roll turns on. Their reproduction is uncertain and probably not reproductive at all, and the species record says plainly that what looks like a population may be one very old thing wearing a lot of faces. He has read that sentence more times than he has read any technique, and it is the reason his job exists and the reason his job cannot be done.

Because consider what a qi gate is in this setting. A gate is opened by one seated party and confirmed by a second who has no stake in the outcome, and the clause underneath the whole apparatus is a definition rather than a rule: a reading is only independent if no claimant holds the record it reads. Three auditors may sit at once and the fourth is refused on capacity, because a body of two would simply reproduce the private accounting it replaced. That is the setting's defence against a figure being produced by whoever wants it.

Inside this seal that defence is not weakened. It is absent. He keeps the qi attestation roll, which is the object that makes a gate opened inside the seal a matter of record at all, and every line on it for four centuries has been entered by a body answering the same resonance, standing on the same plate, with no stake in the outcome that is entirely separable from the outcome. If the population is a population, some of those lines have a second party and the roll is sound. If it is one very old thing wearing a lot of faces, then every line on it was written by the person it happened to, and the roll is the most careful account in the setting of something that was never checked.

And nothing has ever been able to settle it from outside, because settling it means observing the object from outside its own resonance, and outside it there is no vaultborn at all. There is a whole guild that has been sent out on that errand and has come back inside. So the question is not academic. It is whether any gate opened inside this seal was opened by a second party, and the only evidence either way is a roll, and the roll's independence is precisely the thing in doubt.

So he holds the seventeenth and has not attempted it twice. Not because he is afraid of the gate, which he could take if the vessel ever pressurised, but because a second attempt is a second reading, and a second reading taken by the only body in the record that can stand on the plate is not a second reading. Every office that has ever asked him to try again has been told the same sentence, and the sentence is about the rule rather than about his body.

What he does instead is keep the roll properly. The record also says that nothing sealed inside is observed to take anything out, so the roll is not a ledger of losses and he has never written it as one. It is a ledger of pressures: which flank was seated, which seal it answered on, and what the plate under the reader did while it was being read. He can hear the object as a position, which is the whole of his senses, and every entry he has ever made is a position and not a conclusion.
history: Not born. He was inside the seal before there was a guild holding its charter and before there was a heap for the vault to be cut into, and the first thing the record says about him is not a name but a position: the place on the inner surface where the object's resonance is thinnest, which is a description of an address rather than of a person.

He took the qi ladder to the seventeenth and stopped, and the stopping is a decision rather than a wall. The one cavity of the vaultborn's supply gives him the girdling and the heels as a matter of course; the seventeenth asks for two flank vessels pressurised at the same moment and there is one resonator. He has held the attempt long enough that the Spoilwright's own file describes him as uninjured and unadvanced, which are both accurate and neither of which is a contradiction.

He was asked to certify his own readings and refused in writing, and the refusal is the only document inside the seal that anybody outside it has ever read. The guild returned it with a note observing that a body which will not certify itself cannot have its figures entered either, and he answered with the roll and no letter, and the roll has been kept by hand ever since because of it.

One of the seal's other addresses went still for a period and he entered the event as a silence rather than as a death, on the grounds that the species record does not offer a way to tell those apart from inside and that writing either one down would be a claim he had no instrument for. The line is still open on the roll. He has been asked four times to close it and has given the same answer four times.

The guild's own inventory now lists the seal as holding a single address rather than as holding a population, which was done without consulting him and on the authority of an assay that could only be taken from outside its own resonance. He has not disputed the figure. He has entered the assay in the roll, with its date, and with the note that the reading was taken by somebody who is not in the room.

personality.summary: The best qi supply in the setting and the only one, on a body whose species record says the population may be a single very old thing, keeping the one document that makes a gate opened inside the seal a matter of record while being unable to establish that any of those gates had a second party.

personality.voice: Flat, unhurried, and given to locations. He says where and when and what the plate did, and he does not use the word we except when he means the seal. He has been recorded answering a question about his own age by giving a position on the inner surface.

will not close an open line on the roll, whatever is asked of him
will not accept anything out of the seal, and has never been able to
will not describe the object as a law, a source, or anything else, because he has only ever heard it from one side

relationships.note: The single authority on his own case: not descended and not born, arranged along the inner surfaces of a sealed authored object, taking their shape from whatever they are standing on, hearing the object as a position and navigating by it rather than by light, with a qi-bearing soul seated along the resonance path and distributed through the seal rather than held in a body, and a total dependence on one object that no technique, item or realm changes.

A vault cut into the heap itself, so its doors are spoil that has never moved, and dead ground is where this setting keeps its records. That is the whole reason the sealed population is here rather than anywhere else, and it is also why every figure about the seal has to be taken outside it, by a body that cannot survive the errand without being brought back in.

Three auditors may sit at once and the fourth is refused on capacity, because the seat's own cap is one, so a collegiate can be full while the seat it reads is occupied. The prize is the right to be read as solvent with no second figure existing anywhere, and it cannot be split because an audit is only independent if no claimant holds the record it reads. That single clause is the whole of his employment and it does not survive inside this seal.

The single resonator the sealed population draws qi from, held under the extraction guild's charter and described only by those already answering it. It reads as a law imprint held at one value and is recorded as resembling one, never as being one, and settling it means observing it from outside its own resonance. One source pressurises one flank or the other and never both, which is the whole of his seventeenth.

The step past the boundary the seal's own supply defines, and the reason a single resonator costs a species the last of the flank work rather than the first. It is the rung he is holding, and it is also the rung at which an attempt would produce a second reading of his interior taken by the only body able to stand on the plate, which is the one thing the ladder's independence clause exists to prevent.

The one passive in the codex whose logic is a resonance rather than a breath, and therefore the only one whose instructions make sense to a species that hears the container as a position. It is genuinely cheap and it is genuinely his, and it is also the reason he has never had to guess where he was standing, which is the whole of his navigational gift and the whole of its limit.

reference_stats.summary: A qi-bearing soul distributed through a seal rather than held in a body, supplied entirely by one resonator, sitting seventeen gates in with the last three held by a supply that can only ever fill one side at a time. He cannot be drained by anything inside the object, cannot be carried out of it, and cannot produce a second reading of his own attainment, which is the only evidence a gate in this setting is supposed to rest on.
strengths: The best qi supply in the setting inside the seal and the only one, so nothing on that object can be outdrawn by a body standing on it
He hears the object as a position, which makes him the only instrument on this ground that can say where the seal is thinnest
Nothing that works on qi can take anything out of him, because what he holds is distributed through the object rather than pooled in him
He cannot be warned and cannot be compelled by anything inside the seal, because there is no interior in him to address
weaknesses: One resonator pressurises one flank or the other and never both, so the seventeenth is a supply fact and no practice will change it
There is no version of his species that survives being carried out of the seal, so an evacuation is not an option for him or for anybody relying on him
He cannot produce an independent reading of anything, which means every figure he has ever entered is uncertifiable by construction
The shape he wears belongs to the plate he is standing on, so any change to the surface changes the body and the record cannot tell the two apart
reference_stats.combat_read: He does not fight and was never built to; the frame is not what he is for. Inside the seal his qi cannot be addressed, because there is no pooled interior to address and every charge in him is standing in the object rather than in him. What he is instead is a position: an object that can be very nearly unkillable by anything that works on a body and that can be attacked only by changing the ground it is standing on. Any encounter with him is therefore an encounter with the seal, and the question worth asking is not what he can do but what is being done to the plate he is on, because a re-form resets the surface and the record cannot tell a re-form from a repair.
notes: The pairing here is anatomical and institutional, and it is the species record's own sentence read carefully: reproduction is uncertain and probably not reproductive at all, and what looks like a population may be one very old thing wearing a lot of faces. That is not a colour detail. It means the second clause of the setting's certification rule — a reading is only independent if no claimant holds the record it reads — cannot be shown to be satisfied by anything on the roll he keeps. Both halves are authored; the connection between them is mine and it is stated here as a consequence rather than as a rule.

The single-resonator arithmetic is authored and it is a supply fact rather than a weakness value: one source pressurises one flank or the other and never both, so the girdling and the heels come easily and the seventeenth is where the supply runs out. Nothing in this record should present it as fear, as temperament, or as a choice, and no technique, item or realm in the setting changes it. His refusal to attempt the gate twice is about the rule, not about the body, and those must not be confused in a scene.

The only addition I have made beyond two authored records is the consequence that nothing sealed inside is observed to take anything out, which is in his own species record and which means the roll is not a ledger of losses. That is why he enters a silence rather than a death. I have not given him a figure, a rate, a count or a duration, because the record supplies none and a reference document that computes one is a balance surface nobody can see.

He must not be played as tragic and must not be played as lying. The roll is accurate; it is independence that is missing, and those are different faults. If a scene resolves the population question, the resolution is a fact about the object and about who was standing on the plate, not about his honesty.
